description: Curated cigar notes from YouTube review corpus (original copy; not transcript paste). Human review before merge.

notes.hr: Cabinet Selection je Ashtonova klasična linija za mirniji stol — zreli habano pokrov, kremasta tekstura i blagi začini umjesto agresivne snage. Profil drži cedar i kavu u prvoj trećini, zatim malo kože i orašastih tonova. Dobar izbor kad želiš srednje tijelo i uredan, predvidiv draw bez iznenađenja.
notes.en: Cabinet Selection is Ashton’s classic line for a calmer session — aged habano wrapper, creamy texture and gentle spice rather than push. Cedar and coffee lead the first third, then a touch of leather and nut. A steady medium-bodied pick when you want a clean, predictable draw without fireworks.

notes.hr: Gran Puro naglašava puni habano karakter marke Punch — zemljani duhan, cedar i začinska toplina, s tijelom koje ne traži žurbu. Nije lagana Connecticut linija: očekuj srednju do punu snagu i duži dim. Najbolje kad imaš sat vremena i želiš okus koji drži rub kroz cijelu cigaru.
notes.en: Gran Puro leans into Punch’s full habano voice — earthy tobacco, cedar and warm spice, with a body that does not rush. This is not a mild Connecticut smoke: expect medium-to-full strength and a longer session. Best when you have an hour and want flavour that keeps an edge through the whole cigar.

notes.hr: Decade je Rocky Patelova linija za slavlje — tamniji pokrov, punije tijelo i slojevit profil: kakao, karamela, espresso i blagi papar u ravnoteži. Jača od klasičnog Connecticuta, ali bez grube grubosti. Dobra kad tražiš maduro karakter uz rum ili viski s toplijim notama.
notes.en: Decade is Rocky Patel’s celebratory line — darker wrapper, fuller body and layered flavour: cocoa, caramel, espresso and soft pepper in balance. Bigger than a classic Connecticut, but not rough. A strong pick when you want maduro character with a warmer rum or whisky.
